```{r, echo=FALSE}
get_experiment_cooc_matrix <- function(dat, expt_name, iterations=0) {
  this_exp = dat %>% filter(experiment_name==expt_name)
  xd_s <- subset(this_exp, subject==unique(this_exp$subject)[1])
  voc = sort(na.omit(unique(unlist(xd_s %>% select(starts_with("label"))))))
  refs = sort(na.omit(unique(unlist(xd_s %>% select(starts_with("image"))))))
  coocs <- matrix(0, nrow=length(voc), ncol=length(refs))
  row.names(coocs) = voc
  colnames(coocs) = refs
  if(iterations>0) {
    for(i in 1:iterations) {
      words <- xd_s[i,] %>% select(starts_with("label"))
      refs <- xd_s[i,] %>% select(starts_with("image"))
      coocs[words,refs] = coocs[words,refs] + 1
    }
  }
  return(coocs)
}

get_experiment_cooc_matrix(ad, "1") 
get_experiment_cooc_matrix(ad, "2A") # exposure phase: choice_image and choice_audio <- passive (not active)
get_experiment_cooc_matrix(ad, "2B") # ""
get_experiment_cooc_matrix(ad, "2C") # ""
```

```{r}
run_subject_trials <- function(xd_s) {
  coocs <- get_experiment_cooc_matrix(xd_s, xd_s[1,]$experiment_name)
  # iterate over trials, handle training and selection/test trials
  for(i in 1:nrow(xd_s)) {
    # should ignore 
    refs = setdiff(unlist(xd_s[i,] %>% select(starts_with("image"))), NA)
    labs = setdiff(unlist(xd_s[i,] %>% select(starts_with("label"))), NA)
    coocs[labs,refs] = coocs[labs,refs] + 1
  }
  return(coocs)
}

run_subject_trials(xd_s)
```

```{r}
# specific to crossact
get_subject_trial_ordering <- function(xd_s) {
  xd_train <- xd_s %>% filter(trial_type=="learning") # remove "selection" and "test" trials
  voc = sort(na.omit(unique(unlist(xd_s %>% select(starts_with("label"))))))
  refs = sort(na.omit(unique(unlist(xd_s %>% select(starts_with("image"))))))
  w_inds = which(startsWith(names(xd_train), "label")) # columns with label info
  o_inds = which(startsWith(names(xd_train), "image")) # columns with object info
  words = list() # words per trial
  objects = list() # objs per trial
  for(i in 1:nrow(xd_train)) {
    if(xd_train[i,]$trial_type=="learning") {
      words[[i]] = as.vector(unlist(xd_train[i,w_inds][which(!is.na(xd_train[i,w_inds]))]))
      objects[[i]] = as.vector(unlist(xd_train[i,o_inds][which(!is.na(xd_train[i,o_inds]))]))
    } else if(xd_train[i,]$trial_type=="selection") {
      words[[i]] = unlist(xd_train[i,]$choice_label)
      objects[[i]] = unlist(xd_train[i,]$choice_image)
    }
  }
  return(list(words = words, objs = objects, 
              voc=voc, refs=refs)) # for indexing
}

# fit an entire group of subjects with a single best-fitting set of parameters
fit_model_to_group <- function(model_name, exp_name, xd, lower, upper) {
  source(paste0("R/", model_name, ".R"))
  xd_exp <- xd %>% filter(experiment_name == exp_name)
  ords <- list()
  for(s in unique(xd_exp$subject)) {
    ords[[s]] <- get_subject_trial_ordering(xd_exp %>% filter(subject == s))
  }
  
  testdat_group <- xd %>% filter(experiment_name == exp_name, 
                                 trial_type == "test", trial_index < 37)
  
  fit <- DEoptim::DEoptim(eval_model_group, lower = lower, upper = upper,
                          DEoptim::DEoptim.control(reltol = .001, NP = 200, itermax = 200),
                          ords = ords, testdat = testdat_group, logLik_only = TRUE,
                          start_matrix = crossact_mats[[exp_name]]) 
  return(fit$optim$bestmem)
}


eval_model_group <- function(parms, ords, testdat, start_matrix, logLik_only = TRUE) {
  total_logLik = 0
  
  for(s in names(ords)) {
    testdat_s <- testdat %>% filter(subject == s)
    res <- model(parms, ord = ords[[s]], start_matrix = start_matrix)
    mat <- res$matrix[testdat_s$target_label, testdat_s$target_image]
    mod_perf <- diag(mat) / rowSums(mat)
    
    is_right <- testdat_s$is_right
    subject_logLik <- -sum(is_right * log(mod_perf) + (1 - is_right) * log(1 - mod_perf))
    total_logLik <- total_logLik + subject_logLik
  }
  
  return(total_logLik)
}


fit_model_per_subject <- function(model_name, xd, lower, upper, par_priors=NULL) {
  source(paste0("R/",model_name,".R"))
  
  ords <- list()
  for(s in unique(xd$subject)) {
    ords[[s]] <- get_subject_trial_ordering(xd %>% filter(subject==s))
  }
  
  # sapply across subjects, save best-fitting parameters, log-liks, and per-subj/-item predictions
  sfits <- tibble()
  fit_results <- tibble()
  for(s in names(ords)) { # s = "p621758"
    xd_s <- xd %>% filter(subject==s)
    testdat <- xd_s %>% filter(trial_type=="test", trial_index<37) # excludes 37-44; Experiment S1's post-sampling phase test trials
    fit <- DEoptim::DEoptim(eval_model, lower=lower, upper=upper, par_priors=par_priors,
                          DEoptim::DEoptim.control(reltol=.001, NP=100, itermax=100),
                          ord = ords[[s]], testdat=testdat, logLik_only=T, # SSE_only=T
                          start_matrix = crossact_mats[[xd_s$experiment_name[1]]]) 
    # re-eval best fit
    best_par <- fit$optim$bestmem
    new_fit <- tibble(subject = s, neg_log_lik = fit$optim$bestval, chi = best_par[1], lambda = best_par[2], alpha = best_par[3])
    print(new_fit)
    sfits <- sfits %>% bind_rows(new_fit)
    best_result <- eval_model(best_par, testdat, ords[[s]], crossact_mats[[xd_s$experiment_name[1]]])
    fit_results <- fit_results %>% bind_rows(best_result)
  }
  return(list(sfits=sfits, fit_results=fit_results))
}

# test function - for crossact, it's all-AFC for adults and kids; need to do 2AFC version for act exp
eval_model <- function(parms, testdat, ord, start_matrix, SSE_only=FALSE, logLik_only=FALSE, par_priors = NULL) {
  res <- model(parms, ord = ord, start_matrix = start_matrix)
  mat <- res$matrix[testdat$target_label, testdat$target_image] # reorder matrix by correct mapping
  mod_perf = tibble(target_label = rownames(mat), mod_perf = diag(mat) / rowSums(mat))
  mp <- testdat %>% left_join(mod_perf, by="target_label") %>%
    select(subject, experiment_name, age_group, age, trial_index, choice_label, target_image, target_label, is_right, mod_perf) 
  logLik_value = -sum(mp$is_right * log(mp$mod_perf) + (1-mp$is_right) * log(1-mp$mod_perf)) 
  if (!is.null(par_priors)) {
    penalty <- sum(.004*(parms - par_priors)^2) # weak Gaussian regularization (penalize deviation from priors)
    logLik_value <- logLik_value + penalty
  }
  if(SSE_only) return(sum((mp$is_right - mp$mod_perf)^2)) # minimize SSE
  if(logLik_only) return(logLik_value) # minimize negative log-lik
  return(mp)
}

# the images in trial 24 are all NA...
```

```{r}
load("data/ind_fits_kachergis.Rdata")
load("data/ind_fits_kachergis_chi1.Rdata")

results <- ind_fits$fit_results %>% 
  mutate(age_years = ifelse(age<18, round(age), "adult"),
         age_years = ifelse(is.na(age_years), "adult", age_years)) %>% # 1 adult had NA age
  group_by(experiment_name, age_years, subject, age) %>%
  summarise(Human = mean(is_right),
            Model = mean(mod_perf)) %>%
  left_join(ind_fits$sfits) 

results %>%
  group_by(experiment_name, age_years) %>%
  summarise(hum_sd = sd(Human), 
            mod_sd = sd(Model),
            Human = mean(Human),
            Model = mean(Model)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Human, Model), names_to = "group", values_to = "Accuracy") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=age_years, y=Accuracy, color=group, shape=group)) + 
  facet_wrap(. ~ experiment_name) +
  geom_point() + # geom_linerange(aes(ymin = )) + 
  theme_classic() +
  ylim(0,1) + geom_hline(yintercept=1/8, linetype='dashed')
```
